package.name: openral_hal_unitree
package.description: Real-hardware bringup for the Unitree hg humanoid family (G1 now): NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 isaac_ros_robots unitree_hg_ros2_control hardware interface plus the isaac_ros_deploy S0 chain (SafetyController, ONNX InferenceController owning the legs, ForwardJointCommandController for the upper body, FreezeController), with a swappable per-policy controller config and the pinned vendor deps.repos. The HAL node itself is the generic openral_hal_node running openral_hal.unitree_real:UnitreeHgRealHAL; robots/g1/robot.yaml reaches this launch through hal.real_bringup.
